title: Teteté people - Wikipedia
text: The Teteté were a small group of Western Tucanoan speakers, who once lived in the Ecuadorian Amazon or Oriente. Today, their territory would lie within Ecuador’s Cuyabeno Wildlife Reserve, a popular site for ecotourism.

title: Tucano language - Wikipedia
text: Tucano, also Tukano or Tucana, endonym ye’pâ-masa yee uúkusehé, is a Tucanoan language spoken in Amazonas, Brazil and Colombia.
